$comment: astro-base-engine config for the DOM Crossfire site (a DOM VIRUS board game, by Chris Cooley; hub: https://domvirus.com/). Run the engine with --site site. brand.siteUrl is the live GitHub Pages address until crossfire.domvirus.com is pointed; targets.production carries the domain (fe launch checks it). The landing page is the game's own page at / (the brief's type is game), and it loads the game, so scripts are expected there. No analytics or tracking ids here.
